summary:
How can we spark children's interest in space science?

Apollo 18 is an interactive game for children, inspired by NASA’s "Build It Yourself" and based on a fork of https://github.com/gdquest-demos/godot-2d-space-game, in which players can design a space mission and select the instruments to take along.
In the game, children learn about exoplanets, black holes, and other universal phenomena, while discovering how scientists use various instruments to study them and gather information.

Unlike "Build It Yourself"—an experience primarily focused on designing a telescope using only text—Apollo 18 invites players to venture out and explore space, visiting scientific targets while destroying asteroids.
